responsibility: Implements the Fuchsia-specific Rust frontend target hook object by defining TARGET_RUST_OS_INFO. It adds the Rust target metadata strings that identify Fuchsia builds to the frontend via rust_add_target_info and then exports them through the targetrustm initializer. This file belongs to GCC’s Rust frontend target-info layer and is distinct from fuchsia.h, which carries the broader compile and link policy for Fuchsia targets.
